'''Persilla Turvey''' was a resident of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]]. She requested that [[Mair Koda]] bring her disks with the latest fashions on them on her trading runs, as well as a bolt of [[vine-silk]].<ref name="TD" />
